title: Helping your child develop critical thinking skills
heroText1: We are a nonprofit organization empowering children to find their own success in STEM through Chess, Math and Computer Science.
heroText2: Our mission is to Empower children with an opportunity to pursue STEM careers and change their life trajectories.
heroText3: We teach underserved children chess, math, and computer science to empower them to pursue STEM majors/professions with the support of professionals
inclusion: Everyone is included. Everyone is welcomed.
